sections.heading: Buzzy Brooklyn Dispensary: Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: What does your Brooklyn dispensary offer?
items.a_html:
Our Brooklyn dispensary offers:

  • Premium flower (indica, sativa, hybrid strains)
  • Pre-rolls and joints
  • Edibles and gummies
  • Vape pens and cartridges
  • Concentrates and extracts
  • Tinctures and topicals
  • Cannabis accessories
We are conveniently located in Brooklyn, NYC. Visit us in Cobble Hill across from the Trader Joe’s. Our shop is easily accessible by subway, bus, or car.
We’re open 7 days a week, 8am – 10pm. Perfect for morning shoppers or evening pickups.

items.q: Can I order online for pickup?
items.a_html: Yes. You can shop online, reserve your cannabis products, and pick them up at our Brooklyn dispensary during store hours.
Yes. All NYC dispensaries, including ours, require a valid government-issued ID to prove you are 21 or older.

items.q: Can I pay with a credit card at a dispensary in NYC?
items.a_html: Most dispensaries accept debit cards and cash. ATMs are usually available on-site. Buzzy accepts cash and debit at this time, an ATM is on site.
